description: Closed change hints. REST remains authoritative. Logical audience is checked against the receiving subscription; it is never a client-selected permission.

events.meaning: A portfolio share holder's permitted view changed. Fixed, revocable token-authorized subscription; no token, resource ID or content in the signal.
The recipient's messaging availability changed. Refresh their inbox, active history and count without revealing a blocked or unavailable conversation ID.
Messages, reads, flags, thread creation or availability changed. No message text or read pointer is transported.
A peer acknowledged delivery or seen through a sequence. No message text, names or attachments.
A recipient notification was inserted, read, seen or deleted. Re-read both new and unread counts; never increment them from a signal.
The authorized identity feed changed. New entries wait behind a refresh banner; availability changes require immediate revalidation.
An already-authorized feed entry or its reactions/reposts changed; applies to post, job and work-update cards.
A comment/reply or pin changed. Refresh visible comments and authoritative count without transporting comment content.
The identity's follows, saves, hides or blocks changed. Does not identify a private follower or blocker.
Generic public projection change only. No source/actor IDs, per-user counters or private existence signals. R5/R6 add publishers for their public surfaces.
Submission, recruiter stage, withdrawal or permitted tracking changed for this applicant or an authorized reviewer. No answers, status, notes or contact values.
Owner drafts changed, were submitted, discarded or expired. Preserve unsaved edits and require a new review when the saved revision changed.

An active authorized reviewer's hiring workspace changed or lost access to a source. No resource IDs, applicant status, notes, private drafts or assignment details are carried. Recheck current permissions before displaying refreshed lists or editors.
An authorized job changed, including closing time, assignment or availability. Does not expose confidential jobs to other organization members.
Owner saved/archived opportunities or alert configuration changed. Job-alert matches separately signal notifications.
The recipient's profile, resume library, avatar or career records changed; public projections receive a separate generic public hint.
The selected organization's permitted profile/team/recruiter context changed. Access loss also invokes server revocation.
The owner's projects, work updates, pulse or activity changed. Published projections receive public hints only when eligible.
Owner portfolio settings or grants changed. Never transport a share token, access code or private portfolio contents.
Authorized shared shortlists or recruiting context changed; recipient selection respects ownership, assignments and shared-list permissions.
Account-owned settings changed in another tab/device. Does not turn on analytics, embeddings, ML or external delivery.
Clear and recheck selected access. Advisory UI hint only; server-side session/membership revocation must work if this hint is dropped or ignored.
An owned export changed state. Its status/download API rechecks current scope. No filename, object key or download URL.
An owned upload changed processing/verification state. No object key, signed URL, scan content or approval assertion.
Generic operational change for currently authorized administrators only, using a server-derived account subscription that does not require a selected workspace. No report/evidence/recipient data.
